final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT bp.player_id, p.bats, AVG(bp.double) as avg_doubles FROM batting_postseason bp JOIN player p ON bp.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.bats != '' GROUP BY bp.player_id, p.bats), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_doubles) as overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.player_id, s1.bats, s1.avg_doubles, s1.avg_doubles / s2.overall_avg as normalized FROM step1 s1, step2 s2 WHERE s2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT bats, AVG(normalized) as avg_normalized FROM step3 GROUP BY bats) SELECT s3.player_id, s3.bats, s3.avg_doubles, s3.normalized, s3.normalized - s4.avg_normalized as difference FROM step3 s3 JOIN step4 s4 ON s3.bats = s4.bats ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
